scope: Versioned durable five-turn batch summaries and bounded use by default WebSocket continuation; not global rolling summaries or real-provider quality

durableMemoryChecks: Dump/restore plus a separate process resumes the saved extraction without another model call
Versioned batch recap survives full backup/restore and checkpoint resume with its ten source messages
Recap retrieval is isolated by owner, tenant, story and responding character
Pending, running, retry and failed checkpoints cannot supply recaps to generation
Changed source text invalidates a completed recap even if IDs and event versions still match
Legacy fact-only checkpoints and malformed recap versions or references are not treated as summaries
A recap without a persisted source digest is excluded rather than trusted
Recovered memory is retrievable by real pgvector and retains message/event provenance
Partial batch progress survives process restart and excludes interrupted replies
Replaying an already committed turn creates no duplicate job or memory
Enqueue and progress roll back with the story turn and recover on a subsequent commit
A crashed lease is reclaimed by only one of two concurrent workers
An expired worker cannot commit after replacement; checkpoint reuse avoids a second extraction
Zero vectors are failures; embedding recovery reuses extraction and writes no partial memory
Cross-story source references are rejected and retries stop at the configured cap
Explicit failed-job replay retains attempt history, checks reviewed state and cannot replay completed work
A valid empty extraction succeeds without embedding or a fabricated memory
Extraction has an abort deadline and a failed attempt is recorded
Over-budget sources stop visibly without truncation or a provider call
Editing source text during embedding prevents stale derived memory from committing
A message/event version mismatch is rejected before any extraction call
A database failure rolls back memory, vector and provenance together; retry uses the saved extraction
Deleting a story during extraction cascades work and rejects late completion without resurrection
Group participants count and derive independently within the same story
Group memory progress shows each frozen character and only their own five confirmed reply sources
Group recap retrieval includes only the responding character's confirmed input/reply sources
A repeatedly crashed job stops at the retry cap instead of being claimed forever
Lowering the retry limit marks already exhausted queued work as failed instead of stranding it
Deleting completed work preserves other stories and every remaining provenance link stays in its confirmed story
Deleting a completed story removes its saved recap from continuation reads
Player view exposes real successful batch provenance and retained counts without returning memory text
Player memory reads reject another owner or tenant before loading jobs
Progress shows three confirmed replies before reaching the five-reply batch threshold
Extracted checkpoints, failure internals, digests and replay details never enter the player response
A source digest mismatch withholds references and never exposes the private digest
Queued, expired-running, retry, failed and completed-with-no-retained-memory states remain distinguishable
Foreign and missing pagination cursors fail identically
Bounded pagination preserves all batches sharing the same microsecond timestamp and global counts
Cross-story event references are withheld rather than becoming player source links
Interrupted or version-mismatched replies cannot be presented as confirmed memory provenance
Legacy stories explicitly report unsupported progress without inventing historical coverage
Deleted stories cannot return remembered progress or stale source IDs
restoredStoryChecks: Restored panel, available actions, event sources and style notes match the saved story
Identity remains frozen after its source changes
Bound worldbook uses the frozen entry after its source changes
Real pgvector retrieval recovers only this story memory
Another story with the same query vector stays isolated
Retrieved memory still links to its original confirmed text
Restored story still rejects a different owner
A pre-backup committed action replays without a second event
Resumed generation preparation includes confirmed state and saved style notes
A new action after restore advances once and preserves resources
Restored message sequence allocates fresh source IDs
Continuing the restored story does not alter another save
A story deleted before backup stays deleted after restore
Replaying the deleted creation request cannot recreate its story
Deleting a restored story cascades its messages, snapshots, state, notes, events, memories and vectors
Deleted story memory is absent from scoped and global retrieval
Late memory insertion and late turn commit cannot resurrect the deleted story
Deletion and rejected late writes leave the other save intact
corruptionProbes: changed vector with same row count rejected
database.extraction: controlled provider; no real model calls

checks.case: oversized accepted input is retained without body generation, credit hold or story effects
input recovery appends to an existing draft without resending
edited input generates once with frozen identity and saved style; oversized older input stays stored
nonempty long history is trimmed by whole turns while saved notes and current input reach the real provider boundary
validated completed batch recap reaches the real WebSocket provider boundary alongside notes and latest input
checks.fixture: seeded synthetic completed summary, not real provider extraction

checks.case: changed source digest excludes stale recap from the next real continuation without dropping notes or latest input
mobile critical depth material is preserved and rejected before generation; error metadata contains no private prompt

browser.model: controlled loopback provider; beta-smoke uses the existing unknown-model 4096/2048 metadata fallback
browser.summaryFixture: Explicitly seeded successful checkpoint for confirmed rounds 6–10 with numeric source IDs and canonical source digest; no real model extraction claimed

limits: Only succeeded source-validated versioned checkpoints are eligible; legacy arrays remain resumable without invented summaries.
At most 20 candidates and 4 whole omitted batches; recap budget capped at 1024 estimated tokens or 25% input capacity.
Default chat templates only; protected system, latest, pinned and depth material retain priority.
No historical backfill, recursive/global rolling summary, complete character-knowledge isolation or real-provider semantic/style acceptance.
Internal summary text remains absent from the player progress API and reading export.
Summary database read errors can fail the request before body generation; unconditional graceful fallback is not claimed.
EXP-05A/05B, EXP-07D and OPEN-01 through OPEN-07 remain open.
